title: Toggle width is cutwidth plus one on graphs of degree at most three
claim: For every connected graph G with at least 3 vertices: (1) peak elimination: a toggle path whose steps cost at most k can be rearranged into a one-vertex-at-a-time path from the empty set to V whose visited cuts are all at most k - 1; (2) by the monotonicity lemma for submodular functions (Fomin and Thilikos 2003, Lemma 1, after Bienstock and Seymour), restated with proof, cutwidth(G) <= k - 1, so the toggle width is at least cutwidth + 1; (3) a monotone sweep along a cutwidth-optimal ordering costs at most cutwidth + floor(maxdegree/2); hence (4) on graphs of maximum degree at most 3 the toggle width, its monotone version and cutwidth + 1 coincide, and with DEEP-HOLES-20261020-001B the least level at which the affine relaxation refutes an impossible Z_p charge network, over any field in which p is invertible, is exactly cutwidth + 1 on connected cubic graphs.
failure_conditions: An executable construction fails on a census graph: peak elimination leaves a cut of size k or a step costing more than k, or uncrossing does not end monotone with cuts at most k - 1.
A control is accepted: the single edge obeying the lower bound, uncrossing unnecessary on every input, or peak elimination with k - 1 keeping every step within k - 1.
foundation_claim_scope: Graph widths that set how many distinctions linear local reasoning must hold to see a charge hole. No claim about native structure, distance or physics.

validation.status: checked: prose proof; check.py runs peak elimination and the uncrossing of Fomin and Thilikos as algorithms on 4,359 toggle paths over the 1,453 census graphs (2,823 paths with removals), checks the monotone bound on every graph, rejects three controls, and agrees with the census; no human or external review
validation.level: V1 prose proof with executable constructions on declared instances; Lemma 2 restated from Fomin and Thilikos (2003); no trusted kernel.
validation.novelty: Lemma 2 is Fomin and Thilikos (2003), Lemma 1 (after Bienstock and Seymour); peak elimination, the sandwich cw + 1 <= tgw <= cw + floor(maxdegree/2), and the depth of a charge hole as cutwidth + 1 on cubic graphs were not found stated (brief search).
